operations.permission: Current company membership and a parent portal assignment, or company-owner authority.

operations.permission: Current company/portal access and a task assignment/role. This lists saved requested work, not provider execution.

operations.permission: Provider read permission plus requester identity or jobs_read_all. Latest 100 matching saved jobs, newest first.

operations.permission: Provider read permission plus requester identity or jobs_read_all. Missing and inaccessible jobs both return 404.

operations.permission: Portal admin/operator. Explicit assigneeEmail additionally requires the designated access administrator and an eligible active portal member. Saves requested work; no external execution.

operations.permission: Designated global access administrator only, for an existing active/invited company member. Exact production/sandbox grant overrides the * default; empty actions deny access. Does not assign company membership.

mcp.transport: POST JSON-RPC; no SSE or session ID

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List only companies assigned to this verified identity.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: Read permitted provider status and evidence. Registration is not proof of live access.

tools.name: list_portals
tools.description: List portals assigned to this identity within the selected company.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List only tasks this identity can access in the selected company.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Save a task in an assigned portal. This records requested work; it does not execute actions in external systems.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update an authorized task. Contributor, reviewer and portal-administrator permissions are enforced by the server.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Read saved jobs submitted by this user; company administrators can read company jobs.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Retrieve a saved job and its result by ID.

tools.name: verify_connection
tools.description: Save a durable, read-only provider identity check and return its job ID. The AWS worker continues after this chat closes. Requires a service verification grant.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique request key, reused when retrying this exact submission.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a saved job. Requires requester rights or a company-job cancellation grant.

tools.name: configure_connection
tools.description: Register or replace this company’s provider configuration. Use an AWS credential reference, never a secret. This does not establish live provider access.

tools.name: set_service_permissions
tools.description: Assign exact service rights to a company member. Exact environment grants replace the all-environments default. An empty actions array denies access. Only the designated global administrator may change grants.

tools.name: set_platform_role
tools.description: Revoke an existing platform authority assignment using a platform-admin-controlled internal OAuth binding. Global authority cannot be created or transferred through the application. The last active platform administrator cannot be removed.

notes: Registered developer applications cannot request orchesphere.admin; set_platform_role remains an internal-authority MCP operation.
Initial 401 challenge requests orchesphere.read only. Insufficient tool scope returns 403 with the required scopes in WWW-Authenticate.
Successful tools include both content text and structuredContent; other tool errors use isError:true.

scopes.orchesphere.read: Read only the current user’s permitted company data. Required for every operation.
scopes.orchesphere.jobs: Create/update authorized tasks and queue/cancel permitted identity-verification jobs.
scopes.orchesphere.manage: Configure permitted connections; service-grant changes still require the designated access administrator.
scopes.offline_access: Receive rotating refresh tokens, bounded by the grant lifetime. Adds no company permission.

limits.pagination: No query, cursor or pagination parameters in v1. page.mayHaveMore is conservative when a cap is reached; it is not an exact total.
limits.idempotency: Only verification accepts Idempotency-Key. Task creation has no idempotent retry guarantee. Read current records after a lost mutation response.

notes: Exact environment rights override the all-environments default. Empty actions deny access.
Nonempty service grants require read; jobs_cancel_all also requires jobs_read_all.
Company viewers receive read-only rights. Scope does not create membership or service/portal/task authority.
Service-permission writes require designated global access-administrator authority.

providers.businessOperations: No provider business-record read/write API is enabled.

errors.401: Missing, expired, revoked, invalid or wrong-resource token.
errors.403: Insufficient token scope or current company/service/portal/task authority.
errors.404: Unknown endpoint or record not found/inaccessible.
errors.405: Method is not supported for this path.
errors.409: State, quota or idempotency conflict; re-read current state.
errors.503: Temporarily unavailable; a lost mutation response does not prove nothing was saved.

credentialRef.description: A company-scoped credential reference, never a provider secret. Omit to retain an existing reference with unchanged authMode; empty string clears it. Browser mode forbids a reference.

actions.description: Nonempty actions require read. jobs_cancel_all requires jobs_read_all. Empty array denies access. Viewer members may receive read-only actions only.
